note: D-031: the gate classifies a worker's decision_required / blocked / clarification_required into one decision class of authority.json and scores confidence; the accountable role still writes the decision. `gate` selects the implementation: `fake` (deterministic keyword table below, for P2) or `jev` (TypeSafe Jev over POST /v1/systemone with TYPESAFE_API_KEY, P3). Below `threshold` the question escalates to the CEO through the origin conversation. An unavailable gate escalates the same way.

jev_provider.note: CEO chose OpenRouter 2026-10-01 (no waitlist; same /v1/systemone body as direct). To switch route edit this block only: direct = https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone, model jev-latest, key_env TYPESAFE_API_KEY; Vercel = https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/typesafe/v1/systemone with an AI Gateway key. The key itself is never in the repo.
